summary: Draws the FPS overlay. Scans the configuration WORD array (count at this+0x1598, data at this+0x159C) for sentinel 4129 (0x1021); on a match toggles the enable flag at this+0xE0 and, when toggled off, clears the overlay counters at +0xE4/+0xE8/+0xEC. While enabled, increments the per-frame counter at +0xE8 and accumulates per-frame delta time into the float at +0xEC from FloatFieldAccessor; when the accumulator passes a float-compare threshold, converts it with CRTFtol into +0xE4 and resets +0xEC/+0xE8. If the integer at +0xE4 is non-negative, formats it via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, renders it into a text surface (this+5740) through TextRenderToSurface, draws it with BitmapDraw_81f0, and copies the region to the display surface with RenderSurfaceFillCopy. Called from UILargeRender (0x00496930).

operations.description: Read config array count at this+0x1598; only proceed to scan when count > 0.
Scan the config WORD array starting at this+0x159C for sentinel value 4129 (0x1021), advancing by WORD and bounded by the count at this+0x1598.
On sentinel match, toggle the overlay enable flag at this+0xE0: new value is (old value == 0).
When the flag was toggled off, reset FPS value at this+0xE4, per-frame counter at this+0xE8, and float time accumulator at this+0xEC to 0.
If the overlay enable flag at this+0xE0 is nonzero, perform the draw update.
Increment the per-frame counter at this+0xE8.
Accumulate frame delta time: float at this+0xEC += FloatFieldAccessor(this).

If the FPU condition-code flags C0|C3 are clear after the accumulation (raw decompiler condition !(v7 | v8)), the accumulated time has passed a threshold; exact comparison semantics are not explicit in the packet.
On threshold: store CRTFtol(accumulator) into the integer at this+0xE4, then reset float accumulator at this+0xEC and frame counter at this+0xE8 to 0.
Only draw when the integer value at this+0xE4 is >= 0.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(textBuffer, "%d", value at this+0xE4) formats the integer value into the local text buffer.
TextRenderToSurface(this+5740, &v14, &v13, 1) renders the text into a text surface at this+5740 and reports the rendered width into v14 and height into v13.
Proceed to blit only if rendered width v14 > 0 and height v13 > 0.
sub_498560(this+5740) prepares the text surface before the bitmap draw; exact behavior is unknown.
BitmapDraw_81f0(textBuffer, 0, v13, 0, v14, 1) draws the formatted text buffer using the rendered dimensions.
RenderSurfaceFillCopy(Accessor(), 0, 0, v14, v13) copies the filled/copied region of width v14 and height v13 into the render surface returned by Accessor.
Return the last status byte in v3; this is a __thiscall member of the overlay state object (canonical name FPSOverlayDraw).
